Previous imageNext imageSlide 1 of 4, Mail back page, Back page of the MailEnd of image galleryPublished30 October 2026Manchester United target Barcelona's Fermin Lopez, with Lisandro Martinez attracting interest from the La Liga side, while Arsenal are eyeing Club Brugge striker Nicolo Tresoldi.
Manchester United are interested in Barcelona's 23-year-old Spain midfielder Fermin Lopez with the Red Devils looking to bolster their attack in January. (Mail - subscription required), external

Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez is set to leave the club at the end of the season, with Barcelona and Atletico Madrid keen on the 28-year-old Argentina international. (AS - in Spanish), external
Arsenal have no concerns about paying a big fee for Club Brugge's £42m-rated German striker Nicolo Tresoldi, with the 22-year-old's value set to increase next summer. (Football Insider), external
A number of Premier League sides are monitoring 26-year-old Minnesota United forward Kelvin Yeboah, with Everton leading the race for the Ghanaian. (Talksport), external
Manchester United's interest is growing in Fulham's 26-year-old Nigeria defender Calvin Bassey. (Teamtalk), external
Barcelona could move for Inter Milan defender Alessandro Bastoni in January after missing out on the 27-year-old Italy international this summer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish), external
Leeds are interested Maccabi Tel Aviv's 24-year-old Malian midfielder Issouf Sissokho. (Football Insider), external
Manchester United will target a new left-back and striker in the January transfer window. (Times - subscription required), external
Crystal Palace will face strong competition from Italian clubs for the signature of Lecce's 21-year-old Portuguese defender Tiago Gabriel. (Teamtalk), external

Nottingham Forest's 23-year-old English winger Omari Hutchinson, who is on loan at AC Milan, will return to the City Ground next summer with the Serie A club set to target Real Madrid's 20-year-old Brazil forward Endrick instead. (Gazzetta - in Italian), external
